==Problem== (6?3) + 4 - (2 - 1) = 5. To make this statement true, the question mark between the 6 and the 3 should be replaced by \text{(A)} \div \qquad \text{(B)}\ \times \qquad \text{(C)} + \qquad \text{(D)}\ - \qquad \text{(E)}\ \text{None of these} ==Solution== Simplifying the given expression, we get: (6?3)=2. At this point, it becomes clear that it should be \boxed{\mathrm{(A)}\ \div}. ==Video(detailed)== https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l6MO9uW2VTA ==See Also== {{AMC8 box|year=1999|before=First
Question|num-a=2}} {{MAA Notice}}
